2016 HYUNDAI SANTA FE
DESIGNED FOR FAMILIES
THAT KNOW HOW TO ROLL.
A re your family dynamics...well, dynamic? Then you’ll appreciate how we offer our
award-winning Hyundai Santa Fe in three distinct configurations: The 5-passenger
Santa Fe Sport, 6-passenger Santa Fe Limited and 7-passenger Santa Fe SE.
There’s even a choice of three fuel-efficient engines – including Santa Fe Sport’s
available turbocharged 265-hp powerplant that’s one of the most powerful 4-cylinder engines in
its class.1 With all of these choices, there’s bound to be a Santa Fe that perfectly fits your needs.
One thing every family needs? A sense of security. Which is why the Hyundai Santa Fe comes
standard with an exceptional array of safety features that includes seven airbags and a host of
advanced driving assist technologies. There’s also the enhanced safety and car care features of
our Blue Link® connected car system, plus a suite of Hyundai Assurance services and benefits.2
But enough about what you need. Let’s talk about what you want. Just look at what’s on this list
of available features: A panoramic sunroof and stylish 19-inch alloy wheels. Ventilated front
seats, a heated steering wheel and 2nd-row captain’s chairs. Blind spot detection, rear parking
assistance sensors and a hands-free smart power liftgate that opens automatically.
The 2016 Santa Fe. Isn’t it time you turned your family’s daily routine into a mini-vacation?
1Midsize SUV segment. Claim based on comparison of specifications on manufacturer websites. 2 Blue Link subscription service agreement
required. Features vary by subscription plan. Blue Link service works using CDMA-based cellular networks in the 50 United States. Blue Link
service is not available where there is no cellular coverage, particularly in enclosed or remote areas. Service availability may be affected by
signal strength, foliage, weather, topographical conditions (mountains) and nearby structures (tall buildings, tunnels) and other factors. For
details and system limitations, visit HyundaiBlueLink.com.
